column1: # Superclass rebasing for Forge 1.20.1 mods (26.3 names): old<TAB>new<TAB>evidence. Mod classes that extend `old`
# extend `new` instead (an era class extending `old` that keeps the 1.20.1 constructor); other references stay.

column3: 1.21.2: CustomRecipe lost its (ResourceLocation, CraftingBookCategory) constructor and id field; 26.3 CustomRecipe has a no-arg constructor and category() = MISC
1.20.5: LootItemConditionalFunction takes List<LootItemCondition> (26.3: Optional<Holder<LootItemCondition>>) and codec() replaced getType(); 1.20.1 subclasses pass LootItemCondition[]
26.3 FarmlandBlock(Block baseBlock, Properties); 1.20.1 FarmBlock(Properties) always reverted to dirt
1.21.2: Ingredient became final over a HolderSet (private constructor); 1.20.1 subclasses call Ingredient(Stream<Ingredient.Value>)
1.20.5: FlowerBlock(Holder<MobEffect>, float seconds, Properties); 1.20.1 FlowerBlock(MobEffect, int ticks, Properties)
26.3 FenceGateBlock(WoodType, Properties) takes gate sounds from the WoodType; 1.20.1 had (Properties, WoodType) and Forge (Properties, SoundEvent open, SoundEvent close)
1.21.6: block entities save through ValueOutput and load from ValueInput; 1.20.1 used saveAdditional(CompoundTag) / load(CompoundTag)
